runner_run_py_invocations_note: The runner executed run.py three times. The first two were Arm-A-only smoke runs (--skip-arm-b) on separately named indexes, writing results-20260925-smoketest*.json; neither receipt was committed, and their README.md output was overwritten by the official run.
